# 函数: rewriteSourceMappingURLs()

```ts
function rewriteSourceMappingURLs(
   compilation: Compilation, 
   args: object, 
   options?: RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions
): void;
```

将当前模板中每个 JS 资源的 `//# sourceMappingURL=...` 指令重写为绝对 URL。当 `debugMetadataUrl`
（`args.encodeData.sourceContent.config['debugMetadataUrl']`）未设置时不做任何处理。

## 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 描述 |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `compilation` | `Compilation` | - |
| `args` | \{ `chunkGroups`: `ChunkGroup`[]; `encodeData`: `EncodeRawData`; `filenameTemplate`: `string`; `intermediate`: `string`; `intermediateAssets`: `string`[]; \} | - |
| `args.chunkGroups` | `ChunkGroup`[] | 该模板所覆盖的 chunk group。 |
| `args.encodeData?` | `EncodeRawData` | - |
| `args.filenameTemplate?` | `string` | - |
| `args.intermediate?` | `string` | - |
| `args.intermediateAssets?` | `string`[] | - |
| `options?` | [`RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions`](../interfaces/RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions.mdx) | - |

## 返回

`void`
